speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Amidst intensifying geopolitical tensions and increased economic uncertainty, Singapore must maintain a high level of trust in our Rule of Law and our legal institutions.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Ministry of Law (MinLaw) will work closely with our partners, stakeholders and the public to strengthen our legal system, enhance access to justice, optimise the use of our limited land resources and support Singapore’s economic development.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: A strong Rule of Law is a fundamental pillar of a trusted government.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will also uphold multilateralism and a rules-based international order by deepening engagements with international organisations.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Singapore recently joined the International Institute for the Unification of Private Law, a leading intergovernmental organisation that develops international treaties and standards in commercial law.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We passed the Courts (Civil and Criminal Justice) Reform Act 2021, which empowered the Courts to conduct remote, asynchronous and paper hearings in a flexible manner.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: This reduced the costs of litigation and improved convenience for Court users.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: In the area of family justice, we are working with key partners, such as the Ministry of Social and Family Development and the Family Justice Courts, to make family legal proceedings simpler and more efficient.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: These efforts aim to reduce acrimony in family proceedings, promote healing in family relationships, and safeguard the welfare of children.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: More Singaporeans and Permanent Residents can now have access to criminal defence aid.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The decision to establish the PDO, which institutionalises public defence within the criminal justice system, was done after extensive consultations with the Law Society of Singapore and the Criminal Bar.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will continue to improve access to justice and legal services for all Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will also continue to partner key stakeholders like Pro Bono SG on initiatives to improve access to justice, such as the set-up of a one-stop portal, for the public to access legal information.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Singapore must continue to remain open to the world and find new ways to stay relevant and maintain trust.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We are working with the Law Society of Singapore to explore industry-wide secondment and exchange programmes to provide our law practices and lawyers with opportunities to gain experience and expertise in growth domains and in key markets.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: To prepare our legal workforce for the future, the Steering Committee on the Reform of Legal Education and Training is reviewing the legal education and training required to develop our legal manpower.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: This will ensure that law students and lawyers continue to be well-equipped with the knowledge and skills they need for practice in the future economy.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will continue to strengthen Singapore’s position as a hub for legal and dispute resolution services, and harness the growth of the legal services sector across the world.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will build on our dispute resolution ecosystem and encourage foreign dispute resolution institutions to broaden and deepen their presence in Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will continue to establish and deepen relations with markets of interest, to capture opportunities for our Singapore institutions, law practices and lawyers.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will also build on the Singapore Convention Week and United Nations Commission on International Trade Law Academy to increase our mindshare and build connections to Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will also continue to build a forward-looking IP hub that creates value for the economy and provides good jobs for Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: To ensure that our IP regime remains relevant and continues to support innovative and creative enterprises, we have updated relevant IP legislation, such as the Copyright Act 2021 and the IP (Amendment) Act 2022.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will continue to support law firms and lawyers’ efforts to leverage technology to improve the delivery of their services and better meet their stakeholders’ needs.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will further enhance the Legal Technology Platform to integrate it with public systems like eLitigation, LawNet, ACRA, and Sign with Singpass, and bring greater seamlessness to a lawyer’s day-to-day workflow.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: MinLaw has been strengthening our legal system, developing our legal industry and improving access to justice.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will continue to engage our key stakeholders, strengthen the partnerships and trust built up over the years, and ensure that our policies remain relevant, to better realise our vision of "A Trusted Legal System; A Trusted Singapore".
